Elegance
The project

Born of the lagoon

Venice is a city built on water by people who had no alternative. Everything came out of that necessity: the engineering, the trade, the beauty. Venezia Eyewear starts there — from the idea that perfect form is born of a constraint, not a whim.

From the Rialto to La Fenice, from the Arsenale to the Accademia, every frame carries the name of a specific place and inherits its character. This is not marketing: it is a design method.

Italian design and engineering
Selected acetates and metals
Proportions worked out on real measurements
Eleven models, no filler

Anatomy

Four measurements that change everything

A frame is not beautiful or ugly in the abstract: it is right or wrong for one particular face. These are the four measurements that decide it.

Eye size
The width of one lens. It determines how much of the face the frame occupies.
Bridge
The distance between the lenses. It decides whether the frame slides down the nose.
Front width
The total width of the front. It should follow the width of the cheekbones.
Temple
The length of the temple. It decides how the frame holds behind the ear.
“
Venice is not visited: it is crossed. And every time it hands back a detail that wasn't there before.
